'''Old Woman Gretch''' is a wastelander who appears in the first episode of the second season of the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]].

==Background==
Gretch is an elderly woman running a small food stand in the post-War [[Mojave Wasteland]].

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Innovator]]===
[[Lucy MacLean]] and [[the Ghoul]] encounter her while chasing Lucy's father. Lucy buys and eats [[flea soup]] from her and inquires about the whereabouts of her father, [[Hank MacLean|Hank]]. Gretch reveals that Hank recently passed this way and took [[Sunburned man|her son]] with him, apparently forced or hired as a guide through the wasteland. Gretch isn't too sad because of the separation, but because her son owed her money, and now she will not get it. Lucy and Ghoul later find this son in [[Vault 24]]: he is already under control— a [[Brain-computer interface chip|brain chip]] has been inserted into his neck. Hank left him as a "messenger" with a message for Lucy, but the boy's head ends up exploding.
